edges.notes: Multiple distinct destination tags and labelled exchange senders are consistent with a shared exchange deposit/omnibus account; not proof of reserve exclusion.

hypotheses.claim: rNxp4h is a shared Binance exchange deposit/omnibus wallet rather than a proof-of-reserves or reserve-replenishment wallet.
supporting_evidence: Multiple small tagged deposits from Bitso, Uphold, Bitget and other senders are visible on the same account.
The two large r39TA transfers use a destination tag and increase the account balance.
disconfirming_evidence: Binance has not published the internal role of rNxp4h.
A deposit wallet could also sweep into a reserve wallet; PoR address crosswalk is still required.

hypotheses.claim: The 20M XRP received by r39TA from raRVLN was almost entirely forwarded to Binance-labelled rNxp4h within 31 minutes.
supporting_evidence: Ledger metadata shows +20M XRP at 20:16:10 UTC.
Ledger metadata shows 10M and 9,999,197.11 XRP sent at 20:47:00 and 20:47:20 UTC.
Account balances reconcile to a residual of about 802.88 XRP relative to the 20M receipt.
disconfirming_evidence: Fungible XRP cannot be traced as identical units.
No trade, sale, customer, reserve or collateral instruction is identified.

hypotheses.claim: The 10M RLUSD transfer to r39TA is a direct Ripple-company payment.
supporting_evidence: The asset is RLUSD issued by Ripple.
disconfirming_evidence: Sender rnhSfm has no Ripple account label and was activated by an unlabelled account.
The Ripple label on Bithomp's transaction row identifies the token issuer, not the sender's beneficial owner.
rNxp4h internal wallet role is not disclosed by Binance; deposit pattern is an inference, not an official classification.
rnhSfm is unlabelled and activated by an unlabelled account; token issuer is not sender owner.
Exact account balance deltas do not trace identical XRP units or establish trade execution.
No reserve accounting, OTC settlement, customer instruction or collateral posting is identified.
